properties.name: The High Line
properties.description: A 1.45-mile elevated linear park built on a former freight rail line. Opened in 2009 and transformed West Side development patterns.

properties.name: Prospect Park
properties.description: Frederick Law Olmsted and Calvert Vaux's 585-acre park, designed in 1866. Often considered their finest work, superior to Central Park in their own estimation.

properties.name: Times Square
properties.description: Redesigned as a pedestrian plaza in 2009 after Broadway was closed to traffic between 42nd and 47th Streets. A landmark case study in tactical urbanism.

properties.name: Domino Park
properties.description: A 5-acre waterfront park on the East River, opened 2018. Part of a broader mixed-use redevelopment of the former Domino Sugar refinery site.

properties.name: Hunters Point South Park
properties.description: An 11-acre waterfront park designed with living shoreline infrastructure and storm surge protection following lessons from Hurricane Sandy (2012).
